themes.problem: To provide a recording tape cartridge equipped with a reel that can reduce a difference between the upper and lower diameters of the hub resulting from winding constriction of the recording tape.
themes.means: The recording tape cartridge 10 includes: a reel 40 which has a bottomed cylindrical hub 42 having a recording tape T wound on the outer peripheral surface thereof; a case 12 which has a top plate 14A and a bottom plate 16A facing each other and houses the reel 40 singly in a manner of being movable along an axial direction between the top plate 14A and the bottom plate 16A; a ring-shaped member 38 fixed to the inner peripheral surface of the hub 42; an engaging gear 54 which is formed at the ring-shaped member 38 while the tooth surface is nearly in parallel to the axis of the reel 40; and a brake member 80 which is supported non-rotatably with respect to the case 12, has a braking gear 82 engageable with the engaging gear 54, and is displaced in the axial direction of the reel 40 with respect to the hub 42
themes.effect: reducing a difference between the upper and lower diameters of the hub resulting from winding constriction of the recording tape

analysis.heterogeneity: 该群包含多种技术方案，涉及不同类型的卷轴结构、制动机构和材料应用。例如，有涉及齿轮啮合制动的方案，也有涉及滑动接触摩擦抑制的方案。
analysis.limitations: 由于证据数量有限且技术细节差异较大，难以形成统一的技术主题。
